name: Parks Closure Status Due to COVID-19: Athletic Facilities
description:
This dataset tracks the closure and reopening status of athletic facilities in New York City parks during the COVID-19 pandemic. Each row represents a single facility, such as a basketball court, handball court, tennis court, or ballfield, and records its location, sport type, surface material, and current status (reopened, active, under construction, or COVID-19 closure). It also captures how each site was secured during closure (fully locked, taped off, barricaded, or fenced), whether nets, rims, or goals were removed and later reinstalled, whether red warning signs were installed or yellow signs removed, and approximate dates for closure, reopening, and equipment restoration. Location data includes borough, park and property names, park district, field numbers, and polygon geometry for mapping.

The data could be used to analyze how park athletic facilities were managed during the pandemic, compare closure and reopening timelines across boroughs or sports, assess the scale of equipment removal and signage,
